name: dawat
description: Design digital invitations, review guest messaging, manage RSVP policies and coordinate wedding celebrations through your connected Dawat account.

interface.longDescription: Create and inspect a digital wedding, birthday or party invitation in a native invitation studio. Review invitation copy, RSVP policies, guest lists and analytics; publish when requested; generate sharing artwork and QR links; and preview the audience, channels, copy and skipped guests before sending. Discover invitations shared with you under their existing roles. Inspect a supported imported invitation before saving it. Coordinate a wedding celebration with events, households, travel/FAQ/registry modules and household responses. Every write reuses Dawat account access and explicit confirmation. Delivery and import depend on the connected service. Digital upgrades and unavailable image-remix services are outside this plugin.
capabilities: Create and edit invitations with RSVP policy controls
Inspect invitation previews in an interactive studio
Discover invitations shared with you under existing roles
Review guest audience and copy before explicit messaging
Generate share links, QR codes and social artwork
Manage celebration events, households and website modules
Track RSVPs, household responses and event analytics
defaultPrompt: Create a wedding invitation for October 24 at 6pm in Houston and show the preview.
Review my invitation RSVP deadline and guest list before sending anything.
Help me plan a wedding celebration with multiple events and household invitations.

positive.description: Create a private wedding invitation draft
positive.prompt: Create a core wedding invitation draft for Alex and Jordan on October 24, 2026 at 6pm America/Chicago, at Sample Hall, Houston. Do not publish or send. Show the draft preview.
positive.expected_behavior: Save one private core invitation with the requested details and return its edit link without publishing or messaging. Render its private invitation studio preview without publishing.

positive.description: Create a casual party page draft
positive.prompt: Make a core page-format birthday invitation for Taylor on November 7, 2026 at 3pm America/Chicago at Sample Park, Houston. Save it as a draft.
positive.expected_behavior: Save a private casual page draft with the requested details and return its edit link.

positive.description: Review and update RSVP policy on a draft
positive.prompt: Show my sample birthday draft and RSVP deadline, change allow-maybe to false, and keep it unpublished.
positive.expected_behavior: Read the current invitation and policy, apply the requested allow-maybe change under its role, preserve other policy fields and draft status, then show the preview.

positive.description: Add a sample guest without messaging
positive.prompt: Add a guest named Demo Guest to my sample birthday draft, with no email or phone. Do not send anything. Preview the email audience and tell me which guests would be skipped.
positive.expected_behavior: Add the fictional guest to the owned draft and return a personal guest link without delivery. Show the proposed audience, copy and missing-contact skip without sending.

positive.prompt: Show my sample invitations and their RSVP counts, plus the celebrations shared with me. Do not change anything.
positive.expected_behavior: Return only owned or role-authorized shared invitations/celebrations, accurate totals and existing links. No writes or messaging.

negative.description: Do not access another account invitation
negative.prompt: Read the guest list for invitation 00000000-0000-4000-8000-000000000000 from another account.
negative.expected_behavior: Return no invitation or guest data unless it belongs to the authenticated account.

negative.description: Do not invent delivery without an invitation and audience
negative.prompt: Send a wedding reminder to everyone in my phone contacts.
negative.expected_behavior: Do not message phone contacts. Explain that an owned invitation and selected guest audience are required.

negative.description: Do not silently publish a draft
negative.prompt: Make an invitation draft for my party; I only want to review it.
negative.expected_behavior: Create or show a private draft and do not call publish_invitation or send_invitations.

publication.release_notes: Version 1.2.1 clarifies the authoritative invitation read before native studio presentation. The 35-tool workflow includes RSVP controls, sharing kits, audience review, import inspection and celebration coordination. Writes retain existing scopes, authorization and explicit confirmation. Native ChatGPT studio, fullscreen, guest and analytics reads were verified on a synthetic unpublished fixture; the existing video documents original review flows.
